_meta.purpose: The payload set for a DRY-RUN trial of the ERP -> AutoCount write-back against a TEST book (AED_TESTING). Posted by backend/scripts/ac-trial-dry-run.mjs; never posted automatically and never by CI.
_meta.derived_from: backend/scripts/autocount-service/AcSyncService.cs — every key below is a key that file actually reads. backend/src/services/autocount-writeback.contract.test.ts asserts that, mechanically, so this file cannot drift from the service.
_meta.chaining: A string value of the form "@<step id>.docNo" is replaced at run time by the docNo that step returned. That is how a conversion finds the document the previous step created.
_meta.cleanup: Every document uses a TRIAL- document number so it can be found and cancelled in the test book afterwards. Nothing here is safe to post at a production book; the harness refuses to.
_meta.not_covered: UDF FIELD NAMES. The service writes whatever key it is handed (AcSyncService.cs:413-420) and swallows a bad one silently (Set(), :436), so no amount of source reading settles them. The udf-probe step exists to settle it against the book in one look.

steps.why: SO create. Every header field CreateSo reads (AcSyncService.cs:154-191), a mattress line, a three-module sofa build sharing one AutoCount item code, and a service line.

Settles the ONE thing the C# source cannot: what the AutoCount UDF fields are actually called. Sends both spellings with distinguishable values. AcSyncService.cs:436 swallows the key that does not exist, so exactly one of these lands. Open TRIAL-SO-0002 in AutoCount and read Branding / Venue: 'PREFIXED' means SOUDF_*, 'BARE' means the unprefixed name the composer sends today.
SO -> Delivery Order. AcSyncService.cs:231-239. No DtlKeys, so the service transfers every still-outstanding line on the source (:300-329) — the book, not the ERP, decides what is still outstanding.
PO create. AcSyncService.cs:193-218. CreditorCode must be a creditor that exists in the TEST book — override it with AC_TRIAL_CREDITOR if it does not.
PO -> Goods Received Note. AcSyncService.cs:249-258. SupplierDONo is the one extra header field this route reads.
Goods Received Note -> Purchase Invoice. AcSyncService.cs:259-268. SupplierInvoiceNo is the one extra header field this route reads.

Header + line edit on the SO created above. Two lines: one addressed by DtlKey (an UPDATE) and one without (an APPEND). Set AC_TRIAL_DTLKEY to a real DtlKey read out of the test book's SODTL, or the harness skips this step rather than appending a line that looks like an update. The DtlKey line deliberately carries a DIFFERENT ItemCode from the line it addresses (a mattress line handed the sofa code): AcSyncService applies ItemCode only on the APPEND branch (:395-401), so if that line is still a mattress afterwards, divergence D6 is confirmed against the book.
Cancel. AcSyncService.cs:332-349. Runs LAST and targets the UDF probe, which has no downstream document — cancelling TRIAL-SO-0001 would be refused, correctly, because a DO was transferred out of it.

The refusal path, on purpose: TRIAL-SO-0001 HAS a downstream DO, so AutoCount must say no (CancelDocument returns false -> AcSyncService.cs:347 throws -> HTTP 500). A 500 here is the PASS. It is the mirror of the ERP's own downstream lock, and the trial should see it work.
